paragraphs: Chapter 990
Episode 245. Kinzelo's Cunning Plan (3)
Kinzelo was growing increasingly anxious.

“We must have tipped off the major powers that we are scheming something here by now, but there's still no significant news...” Berakt said, looking around. The lanterns were still flickering, and Lanke was continuously chanting necromantic spells, his face pale and haggard. He hadn't slept a wink in the past two days.

“That's for sure. It's really dragging on, considering we're risking our lives here. These bastards can't possibly ignore this place completely, can they? Berakt.” Bardrei clicked his tongue and looked up at the night sky.
“Other guys might not know, but Jin Lunkandel and his followers are closest, so they must have noticed. At this rate, I wonder if they'll really just withdraw.”
As he said, Jin and the Barmel Alliance already knew that Kinzelo was planning something in the Mithra Desert.
They had no intention of falling for their blatant trick. Jin suspected that Kinzelo had taken a desperate gamble to draw the Barmel Alliance and the Jeokmyeok clan.
“If you're that restless, try meditating, Bardrei.”
“What? You were the one who said there's no news yet and made the patiently waiting person anxious.”
Just as Berakt was about to sigh, Bardrei suddenly pointed to the sky.
“Hey! What's that, a dragon!?”
Kinzelo's party, except Lanke, all looked up simultaneously. They naturally thought the dragon was Murakaniiri, but this dragon had a distinctly red hide, easily recognizable from a distance.
“Fire Dragon Kadun...!?”
Kellic's guardian dragon, Kadun, had brought the Fire Dragon Corps to the Mithra Desert.
“What's going on? I didn't expect Jipil to be the first to charge in.”
There was no reason for Jipil to be the first to find the Mithra Desert. Berakt thought they might have come to propose negotiations first.
But the next moment, Fire Dragon Kadun roared loudly enough to shake the entire sky.
“Kinzelo! Leave the Sovereign clan of Raprarosa alone! Why are you, not the Barmel Alliance, trying to bring them out into the open?”
At those words, Kinzelo and his party's thoughts came to a temporary halt. They blinked their eyes, unable to believe their own ears.
"What, what did he say? Berakt, did I hear what that fire dragon said correctly?"
"Huh."
Roar!

Then Kadun spewed flames towards the ground. Kinzelo and his party uniformly spread their sword barrier to block his breath, but Kadun's flames didn't feel particularly threatening. It was a flashy attack with a large range but felt entirely insubstantial, much like Bubar's lanterns.
Berakt realized something at that moment.
“Kellic must have sent Kadun to help us..."
"What?"
"He's trying to make it easier for us to call forth the Jeokmyeok clan and ally with them."
"I wondered why the flames were so lackluster. So that's what it was."
"Berakt, so... we, don't, fight?"

"We have to play along with their act. Pretend to fight moderately while we bide our time. Until the Jeokmyeok clan and the Barmel Alliance arrive. And how they figured out our plan so precisely... It must be the power of the Ma Shin Stone."
There couldn't have been a spy, and Jipil had no one capable of infiltrating to Yona's level.
Berakt suddenly felt a chill at the realization that Jipil had perfectly read Kinzelo's plan just by using the Ma Shin Stone from where he was sitting.

‘The Ma Shin Stone... If we could have continued to possess that item, a new world would have opened up with the completion of our grand work by now. I must hope for an opportunity to seize the Ma Shin Stone someday.’
Kadun continued to spew lukewarm breath, screaming out loud.

"Hmph, what deal did you make with the Barmel Alliance? Or perhaps, you are trying to use the Sovereign clan directly. Either way, Jipil cannot allow it. Either leave immediately or become ashes in my flames; the choice is yours."
Critil (formerly Drakka), the Throne of War God.
"War God brethren! Kinzelo's minions and now even Jipil's dragons have appeared in the Mithra Desert," Rakiman said, kneeling before the throne.
The Jeokmyeok clan had confirmed this fact just after Jipil noticed. They had been watching, wondering what the cornered rats might do, when suddenly Jipil appeared as well.
"Ho-ho, Jipil?"
"Yes, reports say that including Fire Dragon Kadun, about 40 fire dragons have been deployed."
"They lost Drakka and are in a state of confusion; if they deployed that many dragons, they didn't just go there for fun."
"Yes, please take a look at this video."
Zing-! As Rakiman lightly pressed his bracelet, a window floated above it. Inside the window, a scene of Kinjelo's superhumans fighting with Kadun was being played.
<Using the Royal Demons of Lafrarosa, your audacity is grand. Did the Barmel Alliance know about this?>
<You must be truly shocked by losing Drakka, Kadun. Has Jipl now decided to survive as a dog of the Barmel Alliance? I don't understand why you're suddenly selling the Barmel Alliance's name.>
<Shut up, aren't you the ones who went under the Barmel Alliance? You must be attempting to release the Royal Demons sealed in the Mithra Desert on their command.>

The voices were being transmitted clearly, but due to interference, the image quality was not good. Therefore, even for Shimatra, it was impossible to verify whether they were really fighting or merely pretending to through the video alone.
However, the authenticity of the fight was not important at all. Shimatra's eyes were gleaming as he focused on one word.
"Lafrarosa...."
Unlike other factions, the Demon Tribe knew nothing about the relationship between the Mithra Desert and the Royal Demons.

-It's not the Azure Tribe but the Royal Demons. There are no known Royal Demons that use red lightning left. As you can see, the Royal Demons are the only ones, and the Sun God you were trying to resurrect is still intact. In other words, you are defeated spirits.
-I'm not dead yet, so I'm not a spirit. So, human Azure Tribe, what's your hierarchy?
-Thirteenth Overlord, the successor of the Gods of Combat.
Suddenly, Shimatra recalled a conversation he had with Jin on the first day he awoke on the surface as 'First-Class Combat King Shimatra.'
"The land of the Azure Tribe's descendants, who bestowed the power of the Royal Demons to Jin Runckandel, must be located in the Mithra Desert."
"That's correct. What will you do, my Combat Tribe brother?"
"It smells fishy, Rakiman."
"Yes?"
"It's highly likely that this is a trap. I don't know if Kinjelo and Jipl are in it together, but still."
"A trap? What kind of...."

"The descendants of the Azure Tribe, they are not active in the current situation. According to our intelligence, Jin Runckandel has only summoned the descendants of Azure in very limited circumstances. There's some constraint, probably related to Lafrarosa."
"Ah, so by threatening the Mithra Desert, presumably the sealing place of the Royal Demons, they might be trying to provoke both Jin Runckandel and us."

"That's right. Jin Runckandel would want to prevent his brothers' land from being violated, and from our perspective, we'd be uneasy about the Barmel Alliance becoming stronger. Plus, Jin Runckandel declared himself the Thirteenth Overlord and the successor of the Gods of Combat. The rest of the Combat Kings and Combat Gods must be sealed in Lafrarosa."
"If that's true, twelve for the fighting kings, and one for the fighting god...! It's
possible that the regular soldiers, like us, might easily surpass ten thousand."

"Moreover, the object called the 'Golden Box' is technologically far advanced for this era. It must also be something that Jin Runkandel acquired from the descendants of Cheongmyeong. Besides, the Barmel Alliance has recently, thanks to that damned old man Eltiot... managed to get parts of Pibil. If the descendants of Cheongmyeong also return, the Alliance's technological prowess will dramatically increase."
Shimart momentarily envisioned Eltiot's cunning face and scowled. Rakiman imagined the addition of Cheongmyeong's descendants to the Barmel Alliance and shook his head vehemently.
"That's why, even knowing it's a trap, we have no choice but to fall into it once. Is the Barmel Alliance not showing any particular signs yet?"
"Yes."

"Either Jin Runkandel knows this is a trap or believes that those currently in the desert cannot handle Lafrarosa. Either way, once we intervene, it will be clear. Rakiman, prepare the air fortresses of Pibil, Patl, and Rital right now."
Three air fortresses.
Excluding the fighting god's air fortress Kri, it amounts to almost 70% of the total power of the enemy tribe.
Other forces could never deploy troops like this. If they sent out such a large force, their headquarters would be invaded.

However, the enemy tribe is the only one currently equipped with a large-scale spatial jump interference device and also has the best spatial jump ability. Therefore, even if 70% of their force leaves the headquarters, there is no risk of an ambush.
"Understood!"
It took less than five minutes for Shimart's order to be communicated to the entire enemy tribe, and within ten minutes, the air fortresses and fleet began preparing for spatial jump.
"Destination, Mithra Desert. Due to chaotic particles, there may be slight deviations, but it's unlikely to deviate significantly from the battlefield!"
"Understood, commence the sortie."
"Enemy!"
With a shrill noise-
A huge dimensional gate, like a red curtain, opened in front of the fleet. They were consecutive dimensional gates.
The fleet first entered the dimensional gate, followed by the air fortresses. Shortly after, the enemy tribe positioned themselves right above the Mithra Desert battlefield.
Below, Kinjelo and his group, along with the dragon Kadun, were in the midst of a battle performance. Shimart smirked as if amused by the scene.
"They were indeed staging a performance. However, they were almost losers in the world until recently. What a pity."
Kinjelo's group and Kadun paused their performance momentarily and looked up at the suddenly appeared enemy tribe fleet.
"For now, let's take over this area. Fire."
Upon Shimart's command, the enemy tribe's fleet began firing simultaneously. Watching the enemies hurriedly retreating, Shimart added,
"And while bombarding them, start analyzing the desert's wavelengths. Let's see if there really is a void space in this desert."
